concerns.text: Verification for T011 relies on manual cross‑checking of quantitative statements against the JSON report, which is not automatically observable. Executability requires a deterministic check (e.g., a script that parses the report and asserts the values).

Verification for T012 asks to confirm that generated figures are “visually sensible,” a subjective criterion that cannot be automatically validated. A deterministic check (e.g., file existence and non‑zero size) is needed.

Verification for T014 requires a manual review of the handoff document to ensure paths are correct, which is not automatable. Executability demands an automated validation (e.g., a script that checks that all referenced paths exist).
